name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
summary: A Visitor to Dun Morogh is an investigative task offered by Beldin Steelgrill outside Kharanos. Mountaineers reported an unfamiliar campfire high on the cliffs overlooking Gol'Bolar Quarry, prompting a scout to check whether the stranger poses a threat to the local dwarves.

sections.title: A Smoke Plume on the Heights
sections.body: Dun Morogh's mountaineers keep a diligent watch over the crags and snowy valleys surrounding Ironforge. When a campfire suddenly appeared high above Gol'Bolar Quarry, it raised eyebrows in Kharanos. Beldin Steelgrill, concerned by the unusual encampment situated directly above a vital dwarven excavation, recruits travelers to scale the ridges and determine whether the mysterious stranger is a benign traveler or an intruder.

sections.title: Meeting the Earthseer
sections.body: Investigating the ridge reveals that the traveler is Earthseer Farsen, a mystic who has set up camp on the windswept heights. Far from being a marauding trogg or an outright hostile spy, this mysterious observer possesses deep spiritual ties to the earth. His presence on the precipice overlooking the quarry begins a journey uncovering deeper disturbances hidden beneath Khaz Modan, ultimately tying into the mystery of the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the visitor?
faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill, stationed outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh, gives the quest after mountaineers report an unfamiliar fire up in the hills.

faq.q: Where is the mysterious campsite located?
faq.answer: The campfire sits high up on the snowy ridges to the east of Kharanos, perched directly overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry excavation.

faq.q: Who is the visitor overlooking the quarry?
faq.answer: The visitor is Earthseer Farsen, a spiritual observer residing in a secluded camp on the heights above the quarry.

faq.q: Why were the dwarves suspicious of the campfire?
faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry is a critical dwarven operation already under pressure from local troggs. Any unknown encampment set high above the pit could easily belong to scouts or hostile forces watching dwarven movements.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
faq.answer: Reporting to Earthseer Farsen leads directly into the quest 'Farsen's Watch' and serves as the opening breadcrumb for the Hall of Thanes attunement chain.

faq.q: Do you need to fight the stranger at the camp?
faq.answer: No. While Beldin Steelgrill prepares you for the possibility of violence, the visitor is Earthseer Farsen, a peaceful observer willing to speak with you.

angles.text: For Bronzebeard dwarves, monitoring uninvited observers overlooking major mining sites like Gol'Bolar is standard security for protecting Khaz Modan's borders.
Meeting Earthseer Farsen connects directly to spiritual communion with the mountain stones, a rare sight in the snowy highlands of Dun Morogh.
Aiding the local mountaineers outside Kharanos ensures the supply lines and quarry workers remain safe from unforeseen threats.
